title: Roasted Yam Soup
description: A comforting and flavorful soup made with roasted yams and spices.
instructions: Peel and chop the yam into 1-inch cubes.
Place the yam on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a large pot, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the roasted yam, chicken broth, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 15-20 minutes.
Tear the warm tortillas into strips and add to the pot.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Serve hot, garnished with additional tortilla strips if desired.
